title: "Sleep & Physical Strength: Exploring the Relationship Between Sleep Duration and Grip Strength in Older Adults"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
---

```{r}
#| label: setup-and-data
#| include: false

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(plotly)
library(jsonlite)
library(htmltools)

# Load verified primary sample (n = 3,014) and full 60+ eligible sample (n = 3,632)
df_primary <- read_csv("data/nhanes_sleep_grip_primary_3014.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
df_60plus  <- read_csv("data/nhanes_sleep_grip_60plus_3632.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Verify exact sample sizes
stopifnot(nrow(df_60plus) == 3632L)
stopifnot(nrow(df_primary) == 3014L)
stopifnot(sum(df_primary$completed_all_6_trials) == 2997L)

# Export compact JSON payload for client-side interactive filtering & recalculation
dashboard_records <- df_primary |>
  transmute(
    seqn = SEQN,
    cycle = cycle,
    age = RIDAGEYR,
    age_group = age_group,
    sex = sex,
    sleep = sleep_hours,
    grip = round(combined_grip_kg, 2),
    max_hand = round(max_single_hand_kg, 2),
    bmi = round(bmi, 1),
    bmi_cat = bmi_category,
    activity = mod_vig_activity,
    wt4yr = round(WTMEC4YR, 2),
    psu = SDMVPSU,
    strata = SDMVSTRA,
    all6 = completed_all_6_trials
  )

json_payload <- toJSON(dashboard_records, dataframe = "rows", auto_unbox = TRUE)
```

 invisible_plotly_dep <- plot_ly(type = "scatter", mode = "markers")

  <!-- ======================= 6. KEY FINDINGS FROM ACTUAL DATA ======================= -->
  <section id="findings" class="section-block">
    <span class="section-kicker">Section 5 · Empirical Synthesis &amp; Analytical Rigor</span>
    <h2 class="section-heading">Key Findings Derived from the NHANES 2011–2014 Data</h2>
    <p class="section-lead">
      All numerical findings below are computed directly from the 3,014 older adults in the merged CDC NHANES 2011–2012 and 2013–2014 examination files.
    </p>

    <div class="info-grid-2">
      <div class="info-card">
        <span class="card-kicker">Finding 1 · Peak Strength at 7 Hours of Sleep</span>
        <h3>Non-Linear (Inverted-U) Sleep &amp; Grip Relationship</h3>
        <p>
          Across the full cohort (<em>n</em> = 3,014), combined handgrip strength peaks among older adults reporting <strong>7 hours of sleep per night</strong> (<em>n</em> = 758; unweighted mean = <strong>62.53 kg</strong>, median = <strong>59.20 kg</strong>, survey-weighted mean = <strong>63.52 kg</strong>). Strength is lower both among very short sleepers (<strong>&le;4 hours</strong>, <em>n</em> = 147; unweighted mean = <strong>58.87 kg</strong>, weighted mean = <strong>57.76 kg</strong>) and among long sleepers (<strong>&gt;8 hours</strong>, <em>n</em> = 344; unweighted mean = <strong>55.15 kg</strong>, median = <strong>52.85 kg</strong>, weighted mean = <strong>55.52 kg</strong>).
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="info-card">
        <span class="card-kicker">Finding 2 · Pronounced Deficit in Long Sleepers (&gt;8 Hours)</span>
        <h3>5.3 to 6.4 kg Lower Strength in Extended Sleepers</h3>
        <p>
          Older adults sleeping <strong>more than 8 hours per night</strong> (<em>n</em> = 344; 11.4% unweighted, 11.7% weighted) exhibit an unweighted mean combined grip strength of <strong>55.15 kg</strong> compared with <strong>60.47 kg</strong> in the recommended <strong>7–8 hour</strong> group (<em>n</em> = 1,649)—a difference of <strong>&minus;5.32 kg unweighted</strong> and <strong>&minus;6.35 kg survey-weighted</strong> (55.52 kg vs. 61.87 kg). At 10 hours of sleep (<em>n</em> = 101), mean combined grip strength drops further to <strong>51.59 kg</strong> (median 47.30 kg).
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="info-card purple-accent">
        <span class="card-kicker">Finding 3 · Demographic Confounding by Age &amp; Sex</span>
        <h3>Why Age and Sex Stratification Matters</h3>
        <p>
          In unadjusted comparisons, short sleepers (&lt;7h) appear similar in overall mean grip strength (<strong>60.77 kg</strong>) to 7–8h sleepers (<strong>60.47 kg</strong>) because <strong>younger seniors (ages 60–69, <em>n</em> = 1,558)</strong> sleep less on average (<strong>6.86 hrs</strong>) and are substantially stronger (mean = <strong>65.17 kg</strong>) than <strong>oldest-old adults (ages 80+, <em>n</em> = 549)</strong>, who sleep longer (<strong>7.47 hrs</strong>) and have lower grip strength (mean = <strong>48.62 kg</strong>). Yet within both males (67.5 kg at &gt;8h vs. 73.9 kg at 7–8h) and females (43.5 kg at &gt;8h vs. 46.8 kg at 7–8h), long sleep remains consistently associated with weaker grip strength.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="info-card amber-accent">
        <span class="card-kicker">Finding 4 · Survey-Weighted vs. Unweighted Estimates</span>
        <h3>Accounting for NHANES Complex Sampling Design</h3>
        <p>
          Because NHANES oversamples older adults and specific racial/ethnic subgroups, applying the 4-year combined MEC weight (<code>WTMEC4YR = WTMEC2YR / 2</code>) with Taylor-series linearization across <strong>28 masked variance strata (<code>SDMVSTRA</code>)</strong> and <strong>61 primary sampling units (<code>SDMVPSU</code>)</strong> shifts the estimated population mean sleep duration from <strong>7.05 hrs (unweighted)</strong> to <strong>7.18 &plusmn; 0.03 hrs (weighted)</strong>, and shifts mean combined grip strength from <strong>59.96 kg (unweighted)</strong> to <strong>60.91 &plusmn; 0.62 kg (weighted)</strong>.
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ======================= 7. METHODOLOGY & LIMITATIONS ======================= -->
  <section class="section-block">
    <span class="section-kicker">Section 6 · Study Design &amp; Critical Caveats</span>
    <h2 class="section-heading">Methodology &amp; Statistical Limitations</h2>
    <p class="section-lead">
      Rigorous observational research requires transparent reporting of measurement protocols, complex survey weighting, and structural limitations.
    </p>

    <div class="info-grid-3">
      <div class="info-card">
        <span class="card-kicker">1. Observational &amp; Cross-Sectional</span>
        <h3>No Causal Claims</h3>
        <p>
          NHANES is a cross-sectional survey measured at a single point in time per participant. <strong>Correlation does not imply causation:</strong> we cannot conclude that sleeping longer or shorter <em>causes</em> muscle weakness. Reverse causation and underlying health status (e.g., subclinical frailty, cardiovascular disease, depression, or systemic inflammation) may simultaneously increase habitual time spent asleep and reduce neuromuscular strength.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="info-card">
        <span class="card-kicker">2. Exposure &amp; Top-Coding Constraints</span>
        <h3>Self-Reported Integer Sleep &amp; Age 80+ Censoring</h3>
        <p>
          Sleep duration (<code>SLD010H</code>) is self-reported in whole hours for weekdays/workdays rather than measured via wrist actigraphy or polysomnography, and does not capture sleep fragmentation, sleep apnea, or daytime napping. Furthermore, CDC top-codes <code>SLD010H</code> at <strong>12 hours</strong> and top-codes age (<code>RIDAGEYR</code>) at <strong>80 years</strong> to protect respondent confidentiality.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="info-card">
        <span class="card-kicker">3. Biomechanical Protocol &amp; Sampling</span>
        <h3>Dynamometer Trials &amp; Survey Weights</h3>
        <p>
          Grip strength was measured in kilograms using a Takei Digital Grip Strength Dynamometer across 3 alternating trials per hand with a 60-second rest interval. <code>MGDCGSZ</code> sums the maximum reading from each hand. While 3,014 participants completed bilateral testing, 606 older adults with valid sleep data lacked bilateral grip scores (due to non-attendance at the MEC, bilateral hand surgery/paralysis, or completing only one hand).
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

          <a href="https://wwwn.cdc.gov/Nchs/Data/Nhanes/Public/2013/DataFiles/BMX_H.xpt" target="_blank" rel="noopener">BMX_H.xpt</a> (Body Measures),
          <a href="https://wwwn.cdc.gov/Nchs/Data/Nhanes/Public/2013/DataFiles/PAQ_H.xpt" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PAQ_H.xpt</a> (Physical Activity).
        </li>
        <li>
          <strong>NHANES Analytic Guidelines (Combining 2-Year Cycles):</strong> Johnson CL, Paulose-Ram R, Ogden CL, et al. <em>National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey: Analytic guidelines, 1999–2010</em>. National Center for Health Statistics. Vital Health Stat 2(161). 2013. (Four-year MEC weights constructed as <code>WTMEC4YR = WTMEC2YR / 2</code>).
        </li>
      </ul>
    </div>
  </section>

</div>
```

#| label: inject-data-script

cat(sprintf("<script id=\"nhanes-data-payload\" type=\"application/json\">%s</script>\n", json_payload))
```

```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  const rawPayload = document.getElementById("nhanes-data-payload").textContent;
  const ALL_DATA = JSON.parse(rawPayload);

  // Helper statistical functions
  function mean(arr) {
    if (!arr.length) return NaN;
    let s = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) s += arr[i];
    return s / arr.length;
  }

  function weightedMean(vals, wts) {
    if (!vals.length) return NaN;
    let sw = 0, swv = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < vals.length; i++) {
      sw += wts[i];
      swv += wts[i] * vals[i];
    }
    return sw > 0 ? swv / sw : NaN;
  }

  function sd(arr) {
    if (arr.length < 2) return 0;
    const m = mean(arr);
    let s = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
      const d = arr[i] - m;
      s += d * d;
    }
    return Math.sqrt(s / (arr.length - 1));
  }

  function quantile(sortedArr, q) {
    if (!sortedArr.length) return NaN;
    const pos = (sortedArr.length - 1) * q;
    const base = Math.floor(pos);
    const rest = pos - base;
    if (sortedArr[base + 1] !== undefined) {
      return sortedArr[base] + rest * (sortedArr[base + 1] - sortedArr[base]);
    }
    return sortedArr[base];
  }

  function summaryStats(records) {
    const n = records.length;
    if (n === 0) {
      return {
        n: 0, meanGrip: NaN, sdGrip: NaN, wtMeanGrip: NaN,
        medianGrip: NaN, q1Grip: NaN, q3Grip: NaN, iqrGrip: NaN,
        minGrip: NaN, maxGrip: NaN,
        meanSleep: NaN, wtMeanSleep: NaN, medianSleep: NaN,
        wtSum: 0
      };
    }
    const grips = records.map(r => r.grip);
    const sleeps = records.map(r => r.sleep);
    const wts = records.map(r => r.wt4yr);
    const sortedGrips = [...grips].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const sortedSleeps = [...sleeps].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const q1 = quantile(sortedGrips, 0.25);
    const med = quantile(sortedGrips, 0.50);
    const q3 = quantile(sortedGrips, 0.75);
    let wtSum = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < wts.length; i++) wtSum += wts[i];

    return {
      n: n,
      meanGrip: mean(grips),
      sdGrip: sd(grips),
      wtMeanGrip: weightedMean(grips, wts),
      medianGrip: med,
      q1Grip: q1,
      q3Grip: q3,
      iqrGrip: q3 - q1,
      minGrip: sortedGrips[0],
      maxGrip: sortedGrips[sortedGrips.length - 1],
      meanSleep: mean(sleeps),
      wtMeanSleep: weightedMean(sleeps, wts),
      medianSleep: quantile(sortedSleeps, 0.50),
      wtSum: wtSum
    };
  }

  // DOM Control References
  const elCohort = document.getElementById("select-cohort");
  const elSex = document.getElementById("select-sex");
  const elSleepMin = document.getElementById("slider-sleep-min");
  const elSleepMax = document.getElementById("slider-sleep-max");
  const elAgeMin = document.getElementById("slider-age-min");
  const elAgeMax = document.getElementById("slider-age-max");
  const elActivity = document.getElementById("select-activity");
  const elBoundLow = document.getElementById("slider-bound-low");
  const elBoundHigh = document.getElementById("slider-bound-high");
  const elDemoView = document.getElementById("select-demo-view");
  const btnReset = document.getElementById("btn-reset-filters");

  function syncSliders(changed) {
    let sMin = parseInt(elSleepMin.value, 10);
    let sMax = parseInt(elSleepMax.value, 10);
    if (sMin > sMax) {
      if (changed === elSleepMin) { sMax = sMin; elSleepMax.value = sMax; }
      else { sMin = sMax; elSleepMin.value = sMin; }
    }

    let aMin = parseInt(elAgeMin.value, 10);
    let aMax = parseInt(elAgeMax.value, 10);
    if (aMin > aMax) {
      if (changed === elAgeMin) { aMax = aMin; elAgeMax.value = aMax; }
      else { aMin = aMax; elAgeMin.value = aMin; }
    }

    let bLow = parseInt(elBoundLow.value, 10);
    let bHigh = parseInt(elBoundHigh.value, 10);
    if (bLow > bHigh) {
      if (changed === elBoundLow) { bHigh = bLow; elBoundHigh.value = bHigh; }
      else { bLow = bHigh; elBoundLow.value = bLow; }
    }
  }

  function classifySleep(hrs, bLow, bHigh) {
    if (hrs < bLow) return "Lower";
    if (hrs <= bHigh) return "Moderate";
    return "Higher";
  }

  function updateDashboard(changedEl) {
    if (changedEl) syncSliders(changedEl);

    const cohortMode = elCohort.value;
    const sexFilter = elSex.value;
    const sleepMin = parseInt(elSleepMin.value, 10);
    const sleepMax = parseInt(elSleepMax.value, 10);
    const ageMin = parseInt(elAgeMin.value, 10);
    const ageMax = parseInt(elAgeMax.value, 10);
    const activityFilter = elActivity.value;
    const boundLow = parseInt(elBoundLow.value, 10);
    const boundHigh = parseInt(elBoundHigh.value, 10);
    const demoView = elDemoView.value;

    const lowLabel = `Lower Sleep (<${boundLow}h)`;
    const modLabel = boundLow === boundHigh ? `Moderate Sleep (${boundLow}h)` : `Moderate Sleep (${boundLow}–${boundHigh}h)`;
    const highLabel = `Higher Sleep (>${boundHigh}h)`;

    // Update control badges
    const baseCohort = cohortMode === "all6" ? ALL_DATA.filter(d => d.all6) : ALL_DATA;
    document.getElementById("badge-cohort").textContent = cohortMode === "all6" ? "6-Trial (2,997)" : "Primary (3,014)";
    document.getElementById("badge-sleep-range").textContent = `${sleepMin} – ${sleepMax} hrs`;
    document.getElementById("badge-age-range").textContent = `${ageMin} – ${ageMax}${ageMax === 80 ? "+" : ""} yrs`;
    document.getElementById("badge-cat-bounds").textContent = `<${boundLow}h | ${boundLow}–${boundHigh}h | >${boundHigh}h`;

    // Filter dataset
    const filtered = baseCohort.filter(d => {
      if (sexFilter !== "All" && d.sex !== sexFilter) return false;
      if (d.sleep < sleepMin || d.sleep > sleepMax) return false;
      if (d.age < ageMin || d.age > ageMax) return false;
      if (activityFilter !== "All" && d.activity !== activityFilter) return false;
      return true;
    });

    // Compute overall KPIs
    const st = summaryStats(filtered);
    const nMales = filtered.filter(d => d.sex === "Male").length;
    const nFemales = filtered.filter(d => d.sex === "Female").length;
    const pctCohort = baseCohort.length > 0 ? ((st.n / baseCohort.length) * 100).toFixed(1) : "0.0";

    document.getElementById("kpi-total-cohort").textContent = baseCohort.length.toLocaleString();
    document.getElementById("kpi-cohort-sub").textContent = cohortMode === "all6"
      ? "Secondary Complete 6-Trial Sample"
      : "Primary Sample (3,632 aged ≥60)";
    document.getElementById("kpi-filtered-n").textContent = st.n.toLocaleString();
    document.getElementById("kpi-filtered-pct").textContent = `(${pctCohort}%)`;
    document.getElementById("kpi-sex-breakdown").textContent = `${nMales.toLocaleString()} Male · ${nFemales.toLocaleString()} Female`;

    if (st.n > 0) {
      document.getElementById("kpi-mean-sleep").textContent = st.meanSleep.toFixed(2);
      document.getElementById("kpi-sleep-sub").textContent = `Survey-Weighted: ${st.wtMeanSleep.toFixed(2)} hrs · Median: ${st.medianSleep.toFixed(1)} hrs`;
      document.getElementById("kpi-mean-grip").textContent = st.meanGrip.toFixed(2);
      document.getElementById("kpi-grip-wt-sub").textContent = `Survey-Weighted: ${st.wtMeanGrip.toFixed(2)} kg (SD: ${st.sdGrip.toFixed(2)})`;
      document.getElementById("kpi-median-grip").textContent = st.medianGrip.toFixed(2);
      document.getElementById("kpi-grip-iqr-sub").textContent = `IQR: ${st.iqrGrip.toFixed(2)} kg (${st.q1Grip.toFixed(1)}–${st.q3Grip.toFixed(1)} kg)`;
    } else {
      document.getElementById("kpi-mean-sleep").textContent = "—";
      document.getElementById("kpi-sleep-sub").textContent = "No matching participants";
      document.getElementById("kpi-mean-grip").textContent = "—";
      document.getElementById("kpi-grip-wt-sub").textContent = "Adjust filters above";
      document.getElementById("kpi-median-grip").textContent = "—";
      document.getElementById("kpi-grip-iqr-sub").textContent = "—";
    }

    document.getElementById("heatmap-tag").textContent = `Displaying n = ${st.n.toLocaleString()} Unique Participants`;
    document.getElementById("violin-tag").textContent = `Cutoffs: ${lowLabel} · ${modLabel} · ${highLabel}`;

    // =========================================================================
    // CHART 1: 2D BINNED DENSITY HEATMAP + MEAN TRAJECTORY OVERLAY
    // =========================================================================
    const hoursAxis = [];
    for (let h = sleepMin; h <= sleepMax; h++) hoursAxis.push(h);

    const gripBins = [
      { min: 10, max: 20, label: "10–20 kg", mid: 15 },
      { min: 20, max: 30, label: "20–30 kg", mid: 25 },
      { min: 30, max: 40, label: "30–40 kg", mid: 35 },
      { min: 40, max: 50, label: "40–50 kg", mid: 45 },
      { min: 50, max: 60, label: "50–60 kg", mid: 55 },
      { min: 60, max: 70, label: "60–70 kg", mid: 65 },
      { min: 70, max: 80, label: "70–80 kg", mid: 75 },
      { min: 80, max: 90, label: "80–90 kg", mid: 85 },
      { min: 90, max: 100, label: "90–100 kg", mid: 95 },
      { min: 100, max: 110, label: "100–110 kg", mid: 105 },
      { min: 110, max: 120, label: "110–120 kg", mid: 115 },
      { min: 120, max: 130, label: "120–130 kg", mid: 125 }
    ];

    const zMatrix = [];
    const textMatrix = [];
    const customMatrix = [];

    for (let b = 0; b < gripBins.length; b++) {
      const bin = gripBins[b];
      const zRow = [];
      const textRow = [];
      const customRow = [];

      for (let hIdx = 0; hIdx < hoursAxis.length; hIdx++) {
        const hr = hoursAxis[hIdx];
        const cellRecs = filtered.filter(d => {
          const inHour = d.sleep === hr;
          const inGrip = b === gripBins.length - 1
            ? (d.grip >= bin.min && d.grip <= bin.max)
            : (d.grip >= bin.min && d.grip < bin.max);
          return inHour && inGrip;
        });

        const count = cellRecs.length;
        const pctSample = st.n > 0 ? ((count / st.n) * 100).toFixed(2) : "0.00";
        const cellMean = count > 0 ? mean(cellRecs.map(r => r.grip)).toFixed(1) + " kg" : "N/A";
        let cellWtSum = 0;
        for (let k = 0; k < cellRecs.length; k++) cellWtSum += cellRecs[k].wt4yr;
        const pctWeighted = st.wtSum > 0 ? ((cellWtSum / st.wtSum) * 100).toFixed(2) : "0.00";

        zRow.push(count);
        textRow.push(count > 0 ? String(count) : "");
        customRow.push([bin.label, pctSample, pctWeighted, cellMean]);
      }
      zMatrix.push(zRow);
      textMatrix.push(textRow);
      customMatrix.push(customRow);
    }

    // Hour-by-hour mean grip lines mapped to the middle of each 10-kg band
    const hourlyMeansUnw = [];
    const hourlyMeansWt = [];
    const hourlyCounts = [];
    for (let hIdx = 0; hIdx < hoursAxis.length; hIdx++) {
      const hr = hoursAxis[hIdx];
      const hRecs = filtered.filter(d => d.sleep === hr);
      hourlyCounts.push(hRecs.length);
      if (hRecs.length > 0) {
        hourlyMeansUnw.push(mean(hRecs.map(r => r.grip)));
        hourlyMeansWt.push(weightedMean(hRecs.map(r => r.grip), hRecs.map(r => r.wt4yr)));
      } else {
        hourlyMeansUnw.push(null);
        hourlyMeansWt.push(null);
      }
    }

    const heatmapTrace = {
      x: hoursAxis,
      y: gripBins.map(b => b.mid),
      z: zMatrix,
      text: textMatrix,
      texttemplate: "%{text}",
      textfont: { color: "#f8fafc", size: 11, family: "Inter, sans-serif" },
      customdata: customMatrix,
      type: "heatmap",
      ygap: 2,
      xgap: 2,
      colorscale: [
        [0.0, "#091526"],
        [0.08, "#0f2c4c"],
        [0.25, "#155e75"],
        [0.50, "#0d9488"],
        [0.75, "#2dd4bf"],
        [1.0, "#facc15"]
      ],
      colorbar: {
        title: { text: "Participants (n)", font: { color: "#e2e8f0", size: 12 } },
        tickfont: { color: "#cbd5e1" }
      },
      hovertemplate:
        "<b>Sleep Duration:</b> %{x} hours/night<br>" +
        "<b>Grip Strength Bin:</b> %{customdata[0]}<br>" +
        "<b>Participants in Bin:</b> %{z} (%{customdata[1]}% of filtered sample)<br>" +
        "<b>Survey-Weighted Share:</b> %{customdata[2]}%<br>" +
        "<b>Bin Mean Grip:</b> %{customdata[3]}<extra></extra>"
    };

    const unwLineTrace = {
      x: hoursAxis,
      y: hourlyMeansUnw,
      customdata: hourlyCounts,
      mode: "lines+markers",
      name: "Unweighted Mean Grip (kg)",
      line: { color: "#38bdf8", width: 3 },
      marker: { color: "#38bdf8", size: 9, line: { color: "#07111f", width: 1.5 } },
      hovertemplate:
        "<b>Sleep Duration:</b> %{x} hrs (n = %{customdata})<br>" +
        "<b>Unweighted Mean Grip:</b> %{y:.2f} kg<extra></extra>"
    };

    const wtLineTrace = {
      x: hoursAxis,
      y: hourlyMeansWt,
      customdata: hourlyCounts,
      mode: "lines+markers",
      name: "Survey-Weighted Mean Grip (kg)",
      line: { color: "#c084fc", width: 2.5, dash: "dot" },
      marker: { color: "#c084fc", size: 8, symbol: "diamond" },
      hovertemplate:
        "<b>Sleep Duration:</b> %{x} hrs (n = %{customdata})<br>" +
        "<b>Weighted Mean Grip (WTMEC4YR):</b> %{y:.2f} kg<extra></extra>"
    };

    const heatmapLayout = {
      paper_bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      plot_bgcolor: "#091526",
      font: { family: "Inter, Segoe UI, sans-serif", color: "#e2e8f0" },
      margin: { t: 40, r: 30, b: 60, l: 75 },
      xaxis: {
        title: { text: "Self-Reported Weekday/Workday Sleep Duration (hours/night)", font: { size: 13 } },
        tickmode: "linear",
        dtick: 1,
        gridcolor: "rgba(148,163,184,0.12)",
        zeroline: false
      },
      yaxis: {
        title: { text: "Combined Handgrip Strength (MGDCGSZ, kg)", font: { size: 13 } },
        tickvals: gripBins.map(b => b.mid),
        ticktext: gripBins.map(b => b.label),
        gridcolor: "rgba(148,163,184,0.12)",
        zeroline: false
      },
      legend: {
        orientation: "h",
        x: 0,
        y: 1.09,
        bgcolor: "rgba(15,30,52,0.75)",
        font: { size: 12 }
      }
    };

    Plotly.react("heatmap-plot", [heatmapTrace, unwLineTrace, wtLineTrace], heatmapLayout, {
      responsive: true,
      displayModeBar: false
    });

    // =========================================================================
    // CHART 2: VIOLIN + EMBEDDED BOX PLOT ACROSS SLEEP CATEGORIES + TABLE
    // =========================================================================
    const catDefs = [
      { key: "Lower", label: lowLabel, color: "#38bdf8", fill: "rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.28)" },
      { key: "Moderate", label: modLabel, color: "#2dd4bf", fill: "rgba(45, 212, 191, 0.28)" },
      { key: "Higher", label: highLabel, color: "#a855f7", fill: "rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.28)" }
    ];

    const violinTraces = [];
    const tbody = document.getElementById("category-stats-tbody");
    tbody.innerHTML = "";

    catDefs.forEach(cat => {
      const catRecs = filtered.filter(d => classifySleep(d.sleep, boundLow, boundHigh) === cat.key);
      const cst = summaryStats(catRecs);
      const pctUnw = st.n > 0 ? ((cst.n / st.n) * 100).toFixed(1) : "0.0";
      const pctWt = st.wtSum > 0 ? ((cst.wtSum / st.wtSum) * 100).toFixed(1) : "0.0";

      violinTraces.push({
        type: "violin",
        name: `${cat.label} (n=${cst.n})`,
        y: catRecs.map(r => r.grip),
        box: { visible: true, width: 0.28, fillcolor: "rgba(7,17,31,0.85)", line: { color: "#ffffff", width: 1.5 } },
        meanline: { visible: true, color: "#facc15", width: 2.5 },
        line: { color: cat.color, width: 2 },
        fillcolor: cat.fill,
        points: "outliers",
        jitter: 0.2,
        marker: { size: 5, color: cat.color, opacity: 0.65 },
        hoveron: "violins+points",
        hovertemplate: `<b>${cat.label}</b><br>Combined Grip: %{y:.1f} kg<extra></extra>`
      });

      const tr = document.createElement("tr");
      if (cst.n > 0) {
        tr.innerHTML = `
          <td><span class="cat-dot" style="background:${cat.color};"></span><strong>${cat.label}</strong></td>
          <td>${cst.n.toLocaleString()} (${pctUnw}%)</td>
          <td>${pctWt}%</td>
          <td><strong>${cst.meanGrip.toFixed(2)}</strong> &plusmn; ${cst.sdGrip.toFixed(2)}</td>
          <td>${cst.wtMeanGrip.toFixed(2)}</td>
          <td><strong>${cst.medianGrip.toFixed(2)}</strong></td>
          <td>${cst.iqrGrip.toFixed(2)} (${cst.q1Grip.toFixed(1)}–${cst.q3Grip.toFixed(1)})</td>
          <td>${cst.minGrip.toFixed(1)} – ${cst.maxGrip.toFixed(1)}</td>
        `;
      } else {
        tr.innerHTML = `
          <td><span class="cat-dot" style="background:${cat.color};"></span><strong>${cat.label}</strong></td>
          <td>0 (0.0%)</td><td>0.0%</td><td>—</td><td>—</td><td>—</td><td>—</td><td>—</td>
        `;
      }
      tbody.appendChild(tr);
    });

    const violinLayout = {
      paper_bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      plot_bgcolor: "#091526",
      font: { family: "Inter, Segoe UI, sans-serif", color: "#e2e8f0" },
      margin: { t: 30, r: 25, b: 55, l: 65 },
      xaxis: {
        title: { text: "User-Defined Sleep Duration Category (Yellow Dashed Line = Group Mean; White Box = Median & IQR)", font: { size: 12.5 } },
        gridcolor: "rgba(148,163,184,0.1)"
      },
      yaxis: {
        title: { text: "Combined Handgrip Strength (kg)", font: { size: 13 } },
        gridcolor: "rgba(148,163,184,0.14)",
        zeroline: false
      },
      showlegend: true,
      legend: { orientation: "h", x: 0, y: 1.09, bgcolor: "rgba(15,30,52,0.75)" }
    };

    Plotly.react("violin-plot", violinTraces, violinLayout, {
      responsive: true,
      displayModeBar: false
    });

    // =========================================================================
    // CHART 3: DEMOGRAPHIC & SURVEY-WEIGHTED SUBGROUP EXPLORER
    // =========================================================================
    const demoTraces = [];
    let demoLayout = {
      paper_bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      plot_bgcolor: "#091526",
      font: { family: "Inter, Segoe UI, sans-serif", color: "#e2e8f0" },
      margin: { t: 35, r: 25, b: 60, l: 65 },
      legend: { orientation: "h", x: 0, y: 1.1, bgcolor: "rgba(15,30,52,0.75)" }
    };

    if (demoView === "age_sleep") {
      const ageGroups = ["60-69 yrs", "70-79 yrs", "80+ yrs (Top-coded)"];
      catDefs.forEach(cat => {
        const yMeans = [];
        const ySEs = [];
        const customInfo = [];

        ageGroups.forEach(ag => {
          const sub = filtered.filter(
            d => d.age_group === ag && classifySleep(d.sleep, boundLow, boundHigh) === cat.key
          );
          if (sub.length > 0) {
            const m = mean(sub.map(r => r.grip));
            const s = sd(sub.map(r => r.grip));
            const se = sub.length > 1 ? s / Math.sqrt(sub.length) : 0;
            const wm = weightedMean(sub.map(r => r.grip), sub.map(r => r.wt4yr));
            const med = quantile(sub.map(r => r.grip).sort((a, b) => a - b), 0.5);
            yMeans.push(m);
            ySEs.push(se);
            customInfo.push([sub.length, med.toFixed(1), wm.toFixed(1)]);
          } else {
            yMeans.push(0);
            ySEs.push(0);
            customInfo.push([0, "N/A", "N/A"]);
          }
        });

        demoTraces.push({
          type: "bar",
          name: cat.label,
          x: ageGroups,
          y: yMeans,
          customdata: customInfo,
          marker: { color: cat.color, opacity: 0.88, line: { color: "#07111f", width: 1 } },
          error_y: { type: "data", array: ySEs, visible: true, color: "#f8fafc", thickness: 1.5 },
          hovertemplate:
            `<b>%{x} · ${cat.label}</b><br>` +
            "Unweighted Mean: %{y:.2f} kg (&plusmn;%{error_y.array:.2f} SE)<br>" +
            "Survey-Weighted Mean: %{customdata[2]} kg<br>" +
            "Median Grip: %{customdata[1]} kg<br>" +
            "Participants: n = %{customdata[0]}<extra></extra>"
        });
      });

      demoLayout.barmode = "group";
      demoLayout.xaxis = {
        title: { text: "Age Group (Years at Screening, Top-Coded at 80+)", font: { size: 13 } },
        gridcolor: "rgba(148,163,184,0.1)"
      };
      demoLayout.yaxis = {
        title: { text: "Mean Combined Handgrip Strength (kg ± SE)", font: { size: 13 } },
        gridcolor: "rgba(148,163,184,0.14)",
        zeroline: false
      };
    } else if (demoView === "sex_sleep") {
      const sexConfigs = [
        { sex: "Male", color: "#38bdf8", fill: "rgba(56,189,248,0.28)" },
        { sex: "Female", color: "#c084fc", fill: "rgba(192,132,252,0.28)" }
      ];

      sexConfigs.forEach(sc => {
        const sub = filtered.filter(d => d.sex === sc.sex);
        if (sub.length > 0) {
          demoTraces.push({
            type: "box",
            name: `${sc.sex} (n=${sub.length})`,
            x: sub.map(r => {
              const c = classifySleep(r.sleep, boundLow, boundHigh);
              return c === "Lower" ? lowLabel : (c === "Moderate" ? modLabel : highLabel);
            }),
            y: sub.map(r => r.grip),
            boxmean: true,
            marker: { color: sc.color, size: 4 },
            line: { color: sc.color, width: 2 },
            fillcolor: sc.fill,
            hovertemplate: `<b>${sc.sex} · %{x}</b><br>Combined Grip: %{y:.1f} kg<extra></extra>`
          });
        }
      });

      demoLayout.boxmode = "group";
      demoLayout.xaxis = {
        title: { text: "Sleep Duration Category Stratified by Biological Sex (Dashed Line = Mean, Solid Line = Median)", font: { size: 12.5 } },
        categoryorder: "array",
        categoryarray: [lowLabel, modLabel, highLabel],
        gridcolor: "rgba(148,163,184,0.1)"
      };
      demoLayout.yaxis = {
        title: { text: "Combined Handgrip Strength (kg)", font: { size: 13 } },
        gridcolor: "rgba(148,163,184,0.14)",
        zeroline: false
      };
    } else {
      // View C: Unweighted vs Survey-Weighted Mean Trajectory by Sleep Hour & Sex
      demoTraces.push({
        type: "scatter",
        mode: "lines+markers",
        name: "Unweighted Sample Mean (kg)",
        x: hoursAxis,
        y: hourlyMeansUnw,
        customdata: hourlyCounts,
        line: { color: "#2dd4bf", width: 3 },
        marker: { size: 9, color: "#2dd4bf" },
        hovertemplate: "<b>%{x} hrs/night</b> (n=%{customdata})<br>Unweighted Mean: %{y:.2f} kg<extra></extra>"
      });

      demoTraces.push({
        type: "scatter",
        mode: "lines+markers",
        name: "4-Year Survey-Weighted Mean (WTMEC4YR, kg)",
        x: hoursAxis,
        y: hourlyMeansWt,
        customdata: hourlyCounts,
        line: { color: "#a855f7", width: 3, dash: "dash" },
        marker: { size: 9, symbol: "diamond", color: "#a855f7" },
        hovertemplate: "<b>%{x} hrs/night</b> (n=%{customdata})<br>Survey-Weighted Mean: %{y:.2f} kg<extra></extra>"
      });

      demoLayout.xaxis = {
        title: { text: "Self-Reported Weekday/Workday Sleep Duration (hours/night)", font: { size: 13 } },
        tickmode: "linear",
        dtick: 1,
        gridcolor: "rgba(148,163,184,0.12)"
      };
      demoLayout.yaxis = {
        title: { text: "Mean Combined Handgrip Strength (kg)", font: { size: 13 } },
        gridcolor: "rgba(148,163,184,0.14)",
        zeroline: false
      };
    }

    Plotly.react("demographic-plot", demoTraces, demoLayout, {
      responsive: true,
      displayModeBar: false
    });
  }

  // Attach Event Listeners
  [elCohort, elSex, elSleepMin, elSleepMax, elAgeMin, elAgeMax, elActivity, elBoundLow, elBoundHigh, elDemoView].forEach(el => {
    el.addEventListener("input", () => updateDashboard(el));
    el.addEventListener("change", () => updateDashboard(el));
  });

  btnReset.addEventListener("click", () => {
    elCohort.value = "primary";
    elSex.value = "All";
    elSleepMin.value = "2";
    elSleepMax.value = "12";
    elAgeMin.value = "60";
    elAgeMax.value = "80";
    elActivity.value = "All";
    elBoundLow.value = "7";
    elBoundHigh.value = "8";
    elDemoView.value = "age_sleep";
    updateDashboard(null);
  });

  // Initial render
  updateDashboard(null);
});
</script>
```
